title: AI-Powered Universal Communication Platform: Breaking Down Barriers Through Collaborative Innovation
summary: The Scott-Morgan Foundation reports that its communication platform enabled Erin Taylor, who has ALS, to introduce Lenovo's CEO at Tech World.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The Scott-Morgan Foundation reports that its communication platform enabled Erin Taylor, who has ALS, to introduce Lenovo's CEO at Tech World. The chapter also describes an Austrian former parliamentarian and a father using related communication tools. The rating reflects demonstrated communication assistance, without assuming permanent recovery.
purpose: Enable people with severe communication impairments to express themselves.
developer: The Scott-Morgan Foundation with Lenovo, ElevenLabs, D-ID, and IRISBOND
deployer: The Scott-Morgan Foundation and participating users
location: Demonstrations at Lenovo Tech World and the Austrian Parliament

ratings.reason: The source reports that Erin Taylor used the system to introduce Lenovo's CEO. This demonstrates a communication capability gain; lasting restoration of independent communication is not established.

ai_role.statement: Eye tracking, language-model prediction, personalized voice synthesis, and avatars are combined to enable communication. The chapter does not separate the contribution of each component.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 15: AI-Powered Universal Communication Platform: Breaking Down Barriers Through Collaborative Innovation

produced_by: Causal conditions are not established separately in the extracted chapter.
must_hold: Eye-tracking input compatible with the participant's abilities
Personalized voice material and an integrated hardware/software platform

headline: AI voice tools help people with ALS communicate

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
